subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Utilizar recursos verbais e não verbais para construção da persuasão em textos da esfera publicitária, de forma adequada ao contexto de circulação (produção e compreensão).

components.description_pt: Identificar recursos verbais usados para construir persuasão em textos publicitários
components.description_en: Identify verbal resources used to construct persuasion in advertising texts
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the strength of evidence used to support specific claims in a text

components.description_pt: Analisar como recursos verbais e não verbais trabalham juntos para persuadir audiência-alvo
components.description_en: Analyze how verbal and nonverbal resources work together to persuade a target audience
components.cc_component_description: Analyze a speaker's use of rhetorical strategies to persuade an audience

components.description_pt: Produzir texto publicitário usando recursos persuasivos verbais e não verbais apropriados ao contexto
components.description_en: Produce an advertising text using verbal and nonverbal persuasive resources appropriate to its context of circulation
components.cc_component_description: Produce writing with development appropriate to the task, purpose, and audience

cc_matches.description: Trace and evaluate the argument and specific claims in a text, distinguishing claims that are supported by reasons and evidence from claims that are not.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
Evaluate a speaker's point of view, reasoning, and use of evidence and rhetoric, identifying any fallacious reasoning or exaggerated or distorted evidence.
